Name: Enya the CatSith - A Small Expansion Mod
Author: Latteholn
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/BxFMIfA.png[/img]
[center][font=Times New Roman][size=3]Enya is a quiet, mysterious figure who lives just beyond the edge of the Cindersap Forest. Most of the villagers in town know her only as the black cat that roams the valley but hidden beneath the fur, is a century-old witch trapped in feline form. Enya has spent decades watching the world change, waiting for the right time, and the right person, to help her return to her human self.

As her story unfolds, the player will embark on a journey not only to break her curse, but to help her form a new coven of witches, in order to unlock and reopen the path to the Witches’ Road.

[/size][/font][/center][center][font=Times New Roman][size=5][b]FEATURES
[/b][/size]
[/font][quote][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• 1 New Marriageable Custom NPC that transforms from Cat to Human, through the help of the farmer. 🐱
[/b][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• Seasonal Sprites & Portraits (Human Enya)
[/b][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• 23 New Events (16 Special Events + 7 Heart Events)
[/b][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• Includes Vanilla NPC's into the storyline
[/b][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• 4 New Maps (+5 Maps for Events Only)
[/b][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• 9 Quests (+1 Crop, Recipe, & Music for quests purposes)🥕🍅
[/b][/size][/font][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]• Subtle references (e.g Agatha All Along, Wicked, Hunger Games Series & etc..)[/b][/size][/font][/quote][font=Times New Roman]

[/font][/center][center][font=Times New Roman][size=5][b]NOTES:[/b][/size][/font][/center][quote][center][b][font=Times New Roman][size=3]• The Witches' Road which is the 15th special event is about 15-20 minutes long, and it also ends with the day ending automatically so please be patient...
• Enya can only be Romanced once she finally turns into a Human. 
• If you reach 8 or more hearts with Enya while she is still in her feline form, she will permanently lose her memories and remain a cat. Events will still function, but her daily dialogues will consist mostly 'Meow.' However, this outcome can still be reversed if you continue helping Enya return to her human form.
• 8 Hearts Event won't trigger unless Enya is finally a Human.
• Do Not Skip Any Events (except Heart Events)﻿
